_readme: This file maps GHL account names to their Railway env var names. Values are NEVER stored here — only the variable names. Claude reads this to know which Railway vars to reference and what to tell Tyler to update. Keep this file in sync with Railway Variables.

active_vars._note: These three vars are what the BusyBee MCP server (Railway) actually reads on every API call. To switch accounts, Tyler copies the right stored values into these three. Railway auto-redeploys in ~90 seconds.
active_vars.GHL_API_KEY: The PIT currently active — sub-account PIT for location-level work, or Agency PIT for agency-level work
active_vars.GHL_LOCATION_ID: The Location ID of the currently active sub-account — not used for agency-level calls

railway_switch.GHL_LOCATION_ID: Not required for agency-level endpoints — leave as-is

agency._note: GHL_AGENCY_KEY is the stored var. GHL_API_KEY is the active var the MCP server reads. Copy the value, do not rename the active var.
never_use_for: Contacts, conversations, workflows, pipelines — these are sub-account level

use_for: Prospect contacts and pipeline (10-stage Locksmith Prospect Pipeline)
Client website (Car Key Kings site in GHL)
car_key_kings.warning: This is a LIVE CLIENT account. Do not test automations here — use Locksmith Master Template for testing.

use_for: Building and testing all automation workflows before deploying to clients
Creating the Strath Locksmith Snapshot (name: Strath Locksmith V1 — May 2026)
locksmith_template.warning: NEVER use for real client data. This is a build and test environment only. All real client work goes into their own sub-account cloned from the Snapshot.

how_claude_uses_this.step_1: When Tyler names an account, match it against the aliases in this file to identify which account object applies.
how_claude_uses_this.step_2: Check the tier field. AGENCY = no Location ID needed. SUBACCOUNT = needs both _KEY and location var.
how_claude_uses_this.step_3: Call get_active_account to confirm which account is currently live in the MCP server.
how_claude_uses_this.step_4: If the active account doesn't match the target, call switch_account with the account key or any alias from this file.
how_claude_uses_this.step_5: The switch takes effect immediately — no Railway redeploy, no manual copy-paste by Tyler.
how_claude_uses_this.step_6: Proceed with GHL tool calls. State which account is active before making any write operations.
how_claude_uses_this.note_on_switch_account: switch_account reads all credentials from Railway env vars at server startup. If a credential is missing (e.g. new sub-account added to Railway), the server must be redeployed once for switch_account to see the new vars. After that, no redeployment is ever needed to switch.

get_active_account.description: Returns the currently active account name, tier, and Location ID. Never returns raw API key values. Call this first before any GHL operation to confirm context.
get_active_account.when_to_use: Always — before the first GHL tool call in any session or task.

switch_account.description: Switches the active GHL account in-memory. Accepts any account key or alias from this file. Takes effect immediately on the next tool call. No Railway redeploy required.
switch_account.when_to_use: Whenever the active account doesn't match the target account for the current task.

switching_accounts_instructions_for_tyle.normal_path: Claude calls switch_account automatically — Tyler does nothing.
switching_accounts_instructions_for_tyle.fallback_if_tool_missing: If the patched main.ts has not been deployed yet, Tyler must switch manually:
switching_accounts_instructions_for_tyle.manual_where: railway.app → project zesty-achievement → service web → Variables tab
switching_accounts_instructions_for_tyle.manual_what_to_do: Find the _KEY and location vars for the target account in this file. Copy their VALUES into GHL_API_KEY and GHL_LOCATION_ID respectively.
switching_accounts_instructions_for_tyle.manual_example: To switch to Car Key Kings: set GHL_API_KEY = value of GHL_STRATH_CARKEY_KINGS_KEY, set GHL_LOCATION_ID = value of GHL_STRATH_CARKEY_KINGS (6D4IPXvCT5SOEct8ah0O). Wait for green Deployed status.
switching_accounts_instructions_for_tyle.deploy_patch: Push ghl-mcp-switch-account-patch/main.ts from the workspace folder to src/main.ts in the GitHub repo (tylerspeer-beep/Go-High-Level-MCP-2026-Complete). Railway auto-deploys.

non_credential_vars.NIXPACKS_NODE_VERSION: Railway build system config — sets the Node.js version used when building the MCP server. Not a GHL credential. Safe to ignore for all API/account work.
